findings.title: Endpoint lacks a sample-size justification
findings.evidence: primary-response reports n=72 without a prospective sample-size rationale.
findings.action: Ask authors to add a prospective sample-size calculation or downgrade the AI summary confidence.

findings.title: Planned power is below the review threshold
findings.evidence: primary-response planned power is 0.72, below required 0.8.
findings.action: Hold strong efficacy or reproducibility claims until the manuscript explains the lower power target.

findings.title: Effective sample size is below the required level
findings.evidence: primary-response effective n=56 after attrition/exclusions, below required n=131.
findings.action: Flag the endpoint as underpowered and require either more data, narrower claims, or an exploratory label.

findings.title: Attrition risk is not reflected in a sensitivity analysis
findings.evidence: primary-response attrition is 18% without a sensitivity check.
findings.action: Request an attrition-adjusted sensitivity analysis before AI summaries treat the result as stable.

findings.title: Effect-size source does not match the manuscript domain
findings.evidence: primary-response uses effect-size evidence from metabolic-screening for oncology-biomarker.
findings.action: Ask reviewers to verify transferability or replace the effect-size prior with domain-matched evidence.

findings.title: Effective sample size is below the required level
findings.evidence: secondary-quality-of-life effective n=56 after attrition/exclusions, below required n=64.
findings.action: Flag the endpoint as underpowered and require either more data, narrower claims, or an exploratory label.

findings.title: Headline claim relies on a secondary endpoint
findings.evidence: secondary-quality-of-life is secondary but appears in the manuscript headline claim.
findings.action: Keep the claim visible only as exploratory unless authors realign the endpoint hierarchy.

findings.title: Subgroup claim is based on too few observations
findings.evidence: subgroup-young-adults uses subgroup n=18, below minimum n=30.
findings.action: Downgrade subgroup language and request a larger confirmatory cohort before profile summaries endorse it.

findings.title: Model has too few events per parameter
findings.evidence: subgroup-young-adults has 6 events for 2 model parameters.
findings.action: Hold model-performance claims until event-count adequacy or penalized modeling evidence is provided.

findings.title: AI summary confidence exceeds statistical-power evidence
findings.evidence: At least one high-confidence manuscript claim depends on underpowered or weakly justified evidence.
findings.action: Reduce AI summary confidence and surface the statistical-power caveat to reviewers.
